scoring_justification: Recompute N(EF) and structural metrics from dos_curve.csv; compare n_ef.txt to paper-reported reference value.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: LaPt2B2C LDA calculation reported in paper: N(E_F)=33.9 (Ry formula unit)^{-1}
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text: 'N(E_F) is reduced to 33.9 (Ry formula unit)^{-1}'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Value is explicitly stated in the paper; used as hidden gold for comparison.

outputs.description: Total density of states curve. The checker will verify that the Fermi energy lies on the low-energy side of a DOS peak and that N(EF) is lower than the peak maximum within 0.1 Ry above EF.
Density of states at the Fermi level. The value will be compared to the paper's reported gold and must be consistent with the DOS curve (self-consistency check).

output_contract.notes: The dos_curve.csv must have sufficient resolution (step ≤ 0.001 Ry) to reliably locate the DOS peak. The n_ef.txt value must match the DOS value at energy_relative=0 within numerical precision.

steps.description: Compare extracted N(EF) to paper gold within tolerance
Validate existence and shape of dos_curve.csv
Check that n_ef.txt value matches DOS at E=0 within numerical precision
Verify that E_F is on the low-energy side of a peak: N(E_F) < max DOS in (0, +0.1 Ry] and DOS increases immediately above E_F
Verify that N(E_F) is substantially smaller than LuNi2B2C value (65.3) by at least 30%
